GRCh38 Native-versus-Cross-Task Chromosome Learning Curves

1 Scope and interpretation

This report compares native evaluation with transfer to the other regulatory task for the cumulative chromosome learning curves. EVN-trained models are evaluated on EVN data natively and SVN data cross-task; SVN-trained models are evaluated in the opposite direction. All models use real negatives.

Chr1 is validation, chr2 is held-out test, and training checkpoints cumulatively add chr3 through chrX. The full-training-pool panels evaluate every checkpoint on the opposite task’s complete 100% training pool. They are common-reference curves, not ordinary in-sample estimates for early checkpoints.

6 Reproducibility notes

  • Solid lines are native evaluations; dashed lines are cross-task evaluations.
  • Color identifies the evaluation dataset, not the model’s training task.
  • Full training pool, validation, and test are displayed with the same metric ranges.
  • The obsolete outer-fold stability analysis is intentionally omitted.
  • Test data are used only for final evaluation.
